title: कविता समीक्षाको शैलीवैज्ञानिक आधार {Stylistic Features of Poetry Analysis}
nepali: कविता विधा रचनाका दृष्टिले सर्वसुलभ, छिटोछरितो र सर्जकको आफनो रुची र खुबीअनुसारको लोकप्रिय विधा हो। यस विधामा सर्जकले आफनो रुची र खुबीअनुसार सानोभन्दा सानो रचना पनि सिर्जना गर्न सक्छ भने वृहत्तम विशालकायकृतिको पनि रचना गर्न सक्छ । यसका लागि सर्जकमा प्रतिभा, व्युपत्ति र अभ्यासको आवश्यकता पर्छ । काव्य रचना गर्दा सर्जकमा काव्यको सैद्धान्तिक स्वरुप प्रति सचेत हुनु आवश्यक हुन्छ । सिर्जनामा सर्जकले नवीनताको खोजी गर्न लेखकलेजीवनजगतका अतिरिक्त पूर्व सिर्जना भएका कृतिको व्यापक अध्ययनलाई जोड दिनु पर्छ । परिपक्व सर्जकबाट मात्र उत्कृष्ट र मूल्यवान कृतिको सिर्जना हुने गर्छ र त्यस्ता कृतिको समालोचना गर्न  समालोचकहरु लालायित हुने गर्छन । मूल्यवान कृतिको समालोचनाबाट पाठकले त्यसको गुणतत्वलाई आफनो जीवनशैलीसँग जोडने गर्छन । कृति समालोचना गर्ने विभिन्नमान्यताहरुमध्ये शैलीविज्ञान आधुनिक भाषाशास्त्रीय मान्यता हो । शैलीविज्ञान कृतिकेन्द्रित भएर समालोचना गर्ने पद्धति हो । यसले कृति भित्रका विशेषताहरूलाई केलाउने कार्य गर्छ । शैलीविज्ञानले साहित्यिक कृतिको संरचना, बनोट र बुनोट आदिलाई खोतल्छ । सैद्धान्तिक विश्लेषणद्वारा त्यसमा अन्तरनिहित कला सौन्दर्य र साहित्यिकताको उदघाटन गर्दछ ।शैलीवैज्ञानिक आधारमा कृति लेखन गर्नका लागि भाषाविज्ञानका क्षेत्रमा पाइने विभिन्न प्रविधिको प्रयोग गरिन्छ । कृतिकोशैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययन विश्लेषणका क्रममा त्यस कृतिको विधागत प्रकृति, विश्लेषणको क्षमता, ज्ञान र त्यसको अध्ययनमहत्वपूर्ण हुन्छ । शैलीविज्ञानमा विकल्प चयन, अग्रभूमि निर्माण, विचलन, समानान्तरता र शैली चिन्हको आदिका आधारमाकृतिको विश्लेषण गरिन्छ । {   In terms of composition, poetry is the most accessible, fast and popular science according to the creator's taste and talent. In this genre, the creator can create even the smallest works according to his taste and talent, and he can also create the largest giant works. For this, the creator needs talent, pedigree and practice. While composing a poem, it is necessary for the creator to be aware of the theoretical nature of the poem. In order for the creator to search for innovation in creation, the writer should emphasize a comprehensive study of previously created works in addition to the life world. Excellent and valuable works are created only by mature creators and critics are reluctant to criticize such works. By criticizing a valuable work, the reader connects its quality with his lifestyle. Stylistics ia modern linguistic theory among the various theories of criticizing a work. american_english: In terms of composition, the genre of poetry is easily accessible, agile, and a popular genre according to the creator's own interest and capability. In this genre, according to their interest and talent, a creator can compose even the smallest piece or can create the most massive, monumental work. For this, talent, erudition, and practice are required in the creator. When composing poetry, it is necessary for the creator to be conscious of the theoretical nature of poetic art. In order for the creator to seek novelty in creative work, the writer must emphasize extensive study of previously created works in addition to the lived world. Only from a mature creator does the creation of excellent and valuable work take place, and critics are eager to critique such works. Through the critique of valuable works, readers connect their qualitative essence with their own lifestyle. Among the various perspectives for critiquing a work, stylistics is a modern linguistic perspective. Stylistics is a work-centered method of criticism. It functions to examine the features within the work. Stylistics investigates the structure, composition, and texture of a literary work. Through theoretical analysis, it reveals the artistic beauty and literariness inherent within it. To produce writing on a stylistic basis, various techniques found in the field of linguistics are utilized. In the course of stylistic study and analysis of a work, the generic nature of that work, analytical competence, knowledge, and its study are important. In stylistics, a work is analyzed on the basis of selection of options, foregrounding, deviation, parallelism, style markers, and the like.
